scope: Separate positively identified main engine/proxy private commit; separate selected periodic isolate heaps. Not a product-group total or physical-RAM measure.
windowContext: Separate ordinary single-lead agent arm: three MCP calls across three completed model turns, not the deterministic matched burst. Plot starts at the actual first model-turn offer and ends at actual reheat-turn completion. Active/model-turn intervals are not CodeGraph-only execution. Actual connected quiet bounds come from the client result after native snapshots, not raw phase envelopes. Initial standing, the later scheduled 60-second post-reheat quiet and post-exit observation are excluded; that later quiet is not the same equilibrium window. No post-exit zero tail. Reheat worker has only three periodic samples in the plotted window: points, not a supported continuous trend.

metricDefinitions.privateCommitMiB: Windows Process(*) Private Bytes divided by 1048576; private committed virtual memory for one native process incarnation, including its threads.
metricDefinitions.heapUsed: Periodic process.memoryUsage().heapUsed divided by 1048576 for one V8 isolate.
metricDefinitions.heapTotal: Periodic process.memoryUsage().heapTotal divided by 1048576 for one V8 isolate; contains heapUsed, not additive.

gapPolicy.missing: Missing/invalid observations and declared time/sequence gaps break curves. No fake zero or gap-fill; no event-weighted snapshot substitution.

coverage: Main-owner selection and helper/expected-incarnation context are independently reviewed. Global quiet ticks do not prove an owner's alive lifetime. Samples are approximately 1 Hz, not exact continuous peaks.
visualQa: Actual native and four-isolate PNG exports inspected at full size and in 1024-pixel-wide report previews. Native/heap units, actual phase labels, separate owner scope and ordinary single-lead three-call/three-turn demand labels are readable. Heap legend headroom prevents curve/text overlap. Three reheat periodic observations are points only; no later-quiet or post-exit tail is plotted. Final containing Markdown layout remains report-owner integration review.
